name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Ura Akiba Hen~
source:
Akihabara is gorgeously decorated, but it also contains darkness for the unaware girls. Numerous events start to happen with the girls there instantly. They participate in obscene cosplay and competitions, get punished for shoplifting or just become targeted in the park.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
秋叶原装饰得美轮美奂，但对毫无防备的少女来说，这里也隐藏着黑暗。少女们立刻在这里遭遇各种事件：参加下流的角色扮演和比赛，因偷窃而受罚，或者仅仅是在公园里成为目标。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
